network.signal_programs: generated by netconvert --tls.guess-signals (NOT observed NYC timing plans)

assumptions: side-street volumes are declared assumptions (no matched counts)
routes: one fixed free-flow fastest path per flow (sumolib, passenger class); no dynamic route choice and no turning-ratio calibration
demand.source: NYC Open Data classification counts, weekday 16-19 h hourly totals (all vehicle classes), 2025

count_record.source: NYC Open Data classification counts, weekday 16-19 h hourly totals (all vehicle classes), 2025

signals_not_retimed.reason: tlsCycleAdaptation.py (Webster) emits programs only for signals that the declared demand crosses; this signal keeps its netconvert program and receives no cycle change, green factor or offset (as in protocol v5)

signal_timing.note: calibrated scenario testbed, not NYC DOT timing plans
